workloads.title: Rich application
patterns: (画面|モック|ダッシュボード|グラフ|フォーム|アプリ|\b(?:ui|ux|frontend|app|apps|dashboards?|charts?|forms?)\b)
workloads.boundary: AppKit UI / server boundary; fixture approval before business data.

questions.question: 主利用者・操作・端末と通常/空/読込/エラー/権限不足/部分データ状態、データアクセス方式は何ですか。

workloads.verification: Fixture UI journeys, accessibility, chart/table boundaries; later dev auth and resource smoke tests.

workloads.title: HTTP API
workloads.boundary: Decide Apps HTTP / Model Serving / platform API client. Apps endpoints use /api/; callers need OAuth and app CAN USE.

questions.question: APIの提供先(Apps/Model Serving/既存platform API)、呼出元、入出力schema、認証/認可、冪等性・競合・エラー・rate limit・遅延要件は何ですか。

workloads.verification: OpenAPI and negative contract tests; later real OAuth, authorization, concurrency and persistence tests.

workloads.title: Notebook / SQL analysis
patterns: (notebook|ノートブック|\bsql\b|探索|分析|可視化)
workloads.boundary: Read-only exploration and reproducible hypotheses; select warehouse/Connect environment explicitly.

questions.question: 分析の問い、対象データと粒度、期間/時間帯、欠損・除外規則、仮説、結論の検証方法と利用者への成果物は何ですか。

workloads.verification: Fixture results and reproducibility; later approved read-only queries with scan/cost bounds.

workloads.title: Delta / Lakeflow processing
patterns: (更新処理|データ.{0,8}(登録|更新|処理)|テーブル.{0,8}(登録|更新)|\b(?:merge|upsert|etl|elt|pipeline|pipelines)\b|パイプライン|取込|取り込|streaming|ストリーミング)
workloads.boundary: Lakeflow Jobs/Pipelines and Delta analytical contracts, distinct from transactional app writes.

questions.question: 入出力テーブル・粒度・主キー、重複/遅延/再実行/削除規則、頻度・件数・期限・品質閾値は何ですか。

workloads.verification: Replay/tie/null/late-data tests; later isolated Delta and pipeline integration.

workloads.title: Managed / streaming ingestion
workloads.boundary: Source connector/CDC or Zerobus; verify connector availability and credentials separately.

questions.question: 接続元、CDC/初期同期、削除・schema変更、スループット、リプレイ、外部接続権限と費用上限は何ですか。

workloads.verification: Schema drift and replay fixtures; live connector/offset/recovery verification.

workloads.title: Transactional Lakebase
workloads.boundary: Transactional PostgreSQL, not Delta row updates; select existing/new Lakebase resources with approval.

questions.question: 正本DB、既存/新規resource、transaction境界、制約・競合・migration/rollback、接続pool、実行identityと最小権限は何ですか。

workloads.verification: Constraint/idempotency contracts; live atomicity, isolation, OAuth rotation and migration tests.

workloads.title: Genie Space / conversation
workloads.boundary: Genie governed natural-language analytics; generic agents are not automatically Genie.

questions.question: Unity Catalog対象、既存/新規space、代表質問と期待SQL/答え、曖昧さ/権限不足、非決定的評価の合格基準は何ですか。

workloads.verification: Versioned benchmarks and negative questions; later conversation API and permission evaluation.

workloads.title: Managed AI/BI dashboard
workloads.boundary: Managed dashboard only when explicitly chosen; otherwise rich analytical UI can be AppKit.

questions.question: managed AI/BIを選ぶ理由、指標/フィルタ/更新頻度、閲覧者権限、配信と公開範囲は何ですか。

workloads.verification: Fixture layout and metric parity; live published credentials and viewer tests.

workloads.title: Reusable business metrics
patterns: (metric.?view|メトリックビュー|\bkpi\b|指標|集計)
workloads.boundary: Unity Catalog metric view semantics shared across SQL, Genie and Apps.

questions.question: 指標の式・粒度・dimension、NULL・時間帯・通貨・結合多重度、既存指標との整合性は何ですか。

workloads.verification: MEASURE parity and boundary fixtures; reviewed SQL/SHOW CREATE diff.

workloads.title: ML training / evaluation / registry
patterns: (mlflow|機械学習|モデル.{0,12}(学習|評価|登録)|予測モデル|需要予測|\btraining\b)
workloads.boundary: Classical ML train/evaluate/register separately from GenAI judge evaluation; governed UC model registry.

questions.question: 目的変数・予測単位/期間、時系列分割とリーク防止、baseline・合格閾値・再現性、model signature、登録/昇格と監視は何ですか。

workloads.verification: Deterministic split/leakage/baseline fixtures; live MLflow run, artifacts, registry lineage.

workloads.title: Model / agent serving
workloads.boundary: Managed inference endpoint; distinguish from Apps HTTP and external platform clients.

questions.question: 入力/出力・signature、model version、endpointの既存/新規、認可、latency/QPS/cost、評価・canary・rollbackと監視は何ですか。

workloads.verification: Inference contract and failure fixtures; live permissions, latency, scale and rollout.

workloads.title: Retrieval / AI Search
workloads.boundary: Governed retrieval/indexing separated from generation and user authorization.

questions.question: 資料と引用・鮮度・削除、chunk/embedding/index、利用者別ACL、検索/生成評価、prompt injectionと費用上限は何ですか。

workloads.verification: Retrieval/grounding/ACL/injection benchmark; live index freshness and permission tests.

workloads.title: AI agents / MCP tools
workloads.boundary: Explicit tool authority, identity and managed/custom MCP boundary; no automatic autonomous writes.

questions.question: 単一/複数agent、managed/custom MCP、tool allowlist/identity、書込承認、予算/停止条件、traceと代表/攻撃評価は何ですか。

workloads.verification: Tool schema, refusal, injection, budget and trace fixtures; live identity and evaluation.

workloads.title: Unity Catalog governance
patterns: (unity\s*catalog|ガバナンス|権限|lineage|データ分類|masking)
workloads.boundary: Governance/read-only inventory first; any grants, masking or ownership mutations require approval.

questions.question: catalog/schema/owner、利用者/実行identity、row/column policy、lineage、監査・保持と権限変更の承認者は誰ですか。

workloads.verification: Least-privilege plan and denied-access cases; live policy checks with distinct identities.

workloads.title: Sharing / federation / Iceberg
patterns: (delta\s*sharing|federation|フェデレーション|外部共有|iceberg)
workloads.boundary: Sharing/federation is an external data boundary, not ordinary local scaffold.

questions.question: 共有先/接続元・read/write・データ範囲、資格情報、契約/保持/失効、ネットワーク・費用・監査の承認は何ですか。

workloads.verification: Access/revocation contracts; live recipient/federated query and scan-budget checks.

workloads.title: Platform SDK / Jobs / IaC
patterns: (\bsdk\b|\bjobs?\b|terraform|\brest\s*api\s*client\b|platform\s*api|bundle|ワークスペース管理|運用自動化)
workloads.boundary: Workspace vs account APIs, explicit profile/target and least-privilege automation identity.

questions.question: workspace/accountのどちらか、対象resource、読み書きscope、認証・run-as、dry-run/diff、retry・budget・rollbackと承認条件は何ですか。

workloads.verification: SDK contract mocks and plan diff; live dev validation with production/destructive human gates.
